clauses.title: Subject
paragraphs: The provider maintains the client's office premises: cleaning, small repairs and the upkeep of the technical installations listed in Annex 1.
Work outside this scope is done only on a written order and is invoiced separately.

clauses.title: Duration
paragraphs: The contract starts on the date of signature and runs for 12 months. It is extended by 12 months at a time unless one party gives written notice at least 60 days before the end.

clauses.title: Obligations of the provider
paragraphs: The provider carries out the work with due care, with qualified staff and its own tools and materials.
The provider reports any damage or risk it notices on the premises without delay.

clauses.title: Obligations of the client
paragraphs: The client gives the provider's staff access to the premises during the agreed hours and names a contact person.
The client pays the invoices within the term agreed below.

clauses.title: Liability
paragraphs: Each party is liable for damage caused by its own fault. The provider's liability is limited to the value of the fees paid in the last 12 months, except for intent or gross negligence.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
paragraphs: The parties keep confidential all information about the other party obtained under this contract, during the contract and for three years after its end.

clauses.title: Termination
paragraphs: Either party may end the contract with immediate effect if the other party seriously breaches its obligations and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of a written notice.

clauses.title: Final provisions
paragraphs: Changes to this contract are valid only in writing and signed by both parties. Disputes are settled amicably or, failing that, by the competent courts at the provider's seat.
This contract is signed in two originals, one for each party.
